milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find gravel' is an observation/locate task — the player must navigate near the 4x4 gravel patch (center at spawn-relative [-5, 0, 5]) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=8 requires the player to approach within viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the gravel, not just passing by. Combined with count_in_box_at_least to verify the gravel patch actually exists in the scene (at least 10 of 16 placed gravel blocks must be present).
